value.basis: Summed over unique API messages in every agent's Claude Code transcript. Input-side counts (uncached input, cache writes, cache reads) are measured; output is estimated as visible characters divided by 4 and excludes hidden thinking, so the total is a lower bound. The tokens of calls through `claude -p` and the gateway are not included.

note: All agents together, 1,160 API calls on claude-opus-5-5: uncached input 2,374 (measured); cache writes 11,077,148 for 5 minutes and 629,472 for 1 hour (measured); cache reads 486,706,975 (measured); output at least 569,760 (estimated). Cache reads are 97.5% of the total: long agent contexts, re-read on every call. The per-agent figures are in the resolution of records/jobs/bootstrap/job.json#cost.
